notes: RNA-seq arm of a ribosome-profiling protocol: RNA fragmented and library made from 20-45 nt fragments -> assay_class other (excluded). Ribo-T strain: tethered-ribosome plasmid in SQ171 plus evolved ybeX/rpsA mutations -> multiple. LB + 0.2% glucose: carbon_source left out. strain_group not given for SQ171.

growth_phase.q: When the culture density reached A600 of ∼0.5 cells were harvested

culture_mode.q: Cultures were grown at 37 °C with vigorous shaking.

base_medium.q: 100 mL of LB supplemented with the same antibiotics and with 0.2% glucose

medium_class.q: 100 mL of LB supplemented with the same antibiotics and with 0.2% glucose

amino_acids_supplied.q: 100 mL of LB supplemented with the same antibiotics and with 0.2% glucose

oxygen.q: Cultures were grown at 37 °C with vigorous shaking.

growth_temperature.q: Cultures were grown at 37 °C with vigorous shaking.

inducer_added.q: compared to a SQ171 control cells carrying WT ribosomes

treatment.q: compared to a SQ171 control cells carrying WT ribosomes

transcription_arrested.q: compared to a SQ171 control cells carrying WT ribosomes

assay_class.q: The library for next-generation sequencing was prepared using RNA fragments ranging in size from 20 to 45 nt.

rrna_removal.q: short RNA and rRNA were subtracted using Ambion MEGAclear kit and MICROBexpress bacterial mRNA enrichment kit

mixed_organism.q: Ribosome profiling and RNA-seq was performed on Escherichia coli Ribo-T

is_control.q: compared to a SQ171 control cells carrying WT ribosomes

genotype_class.q: The Ribo-T strain carries two mutations: a nonsense mutation in the Leu22 codon of the ybeX gene and a missense mutation in codon 549 of the rpsA gene

perturbed_genes.q: The Ribo-T strain carries two mutations: a nonsense mutation in the Leu22 codon of the ybeX gene and a missense mutation in codon 549 of the rpsA gene
